label: Stakeholder Mapping
description: Map stakeholder power and interest, design engagement strategies, identify blockers, and build communication plans for complex change programmes.

guidedInputs.label: Project or change description
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Implementing a new AML transaction monitoring platform across the bank. Affects compliance, IT, operations, front office, and finance. 12-month programme.

guidedInputs.label: Key stakeholders (list who you know)
guidedInputs.description: List the key people and roles involved. ANTON will help identify ones you may have missed.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., CRO (project sponsor), Head of Compliance, CIO, Head of Operations, CFO, Head of Retail Banking, External regulator (FI)...

guidedInputs.label: Known concerns or resistance
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., IT is understaffed and concerned about timeline. Head of Retail Banking worried about customer impact during migration. CFO questioning the ROI.
